lines: Badfish beat the living shit out of TheTunaSquad, 171.4 to 83.8. That's not a matchup, that's a fucking crime scene.
Still Renovating dropped 173.2 in week 7. Hottest fucking lineup in the league, and they won't shut up about it.
DetroitDumpsterFire put up a pathetic 79.6. A kicker and a prayer would've scored more.
A new dawn rising left 18.4 points rotting on the bench with Omar Cooper Jr. sitting there while Xavier Worthy took a dump. Benching genius.
SaquonMyPickens scored 135.6 and still fucking lost. The fantasy gods took a dump on that roster.
